disposition_mapping.rationale: Trial balance close confirmation is preserved unchanged as the opening gate for the period-end cycle, satisfying the cutoff-discipline requirement (KB-03) and the explicit survival requirement FSP-R-10.

Posting of approved adjustments continues to consume the approved adjustment schedule and revenue cut-off evidence unchanged, preserving accrual-basis and cut-off requirements (KB-01, KB-13) and FSP-R-02/FSP-R-06.

Consolidation and intercompany elimination are merged with foreign-operation translation into one group-accountant step; the intercompany identification/matching/elimination obligation under IFRS 10 (KB-14) is fully retained and still consumes intercompany balances and transactions, satisfying FSP-R-03.

Translation of the foreign operation is merged into the same group-accountant consolidation step; closing/average rates are still consumed and translation differences still separately output to OCI, preserving IAS 21 (KB-07, KB-08) and FSP-R-04.

Mapping to statement line items is merged into the Financial-reporting drafting step since it is a mechanical precursor to drafting performed by the same actor; the statement line-item structure is still consumed, satisfying FSP-R-05.

Drafting of primary statements and key notes persists, now combined with mapping, and continues to consume the accounting policy change and prior-period error record, satisfying FSP-R-07 and the explicit survival requirement FSP-R-11; ordering after trial balance close (FSP-R-01) is preserved since TS-01 precedes TS-04.

Analytical review and tie-out is restructured with system-assisted tie-out tooling but remains a distinct preparer-side control preserving the evidential trail (KB-02); this step is unconstrained by design, so restructuring is discretionary.

Management review and approval is retained with the CFO actor unchanged and kept organisationally separate from the drafting function (TS-04), satisfying the survival requirement FSP-R-09 and the actor-separation requirement FSP-R-08.
Release/submission is retained as the final step, with optional automation of distribution/filing mechanics; this step is unconstrained by design.

steps.description: Subledger closure and reconciliation completion are confirmed via automated close-status monitoring, establishing the closed, reconciled trial balance. Preserves the period-end cutoff discipline (KB-03) that gates all downstream reporting.
steps.name: Confirm trial balance close

steps.description: Approved accruals, provisions, deferrals and cut-off adjustments are posted against the closed trial balance, with revenue cut-off evidence verified. Estimation entries (provisions, NRV write-downs, ECL) retain an accountable human preparer per KB-04/KB-10/KB-12; mechanical accruals may be system-generated from the approved schedule but still require this human posting/sign-off step.
steps.name: Post period-end adjustments

steps.description: Entity trial balances, including the foreign subsidiary's results and position, are consolidated in a single group-accountant-owned step: intercompany balances and transactions are matched and eliminated in full (KB-14), and foreign-currency balances are retranslated at closing/average rates with translation differences routed to OCI (KB-07, KB-08). Combining consolidation and translation removes a handoff without dropping either computation, both of which remain mandatory and separately evidenced in the outputs.
steps.name: Consolidate, eliminate intercompany, and translate foreign operations

steps.description: The consolidated and translated trial balance is mapped to the statement line-item structure and used to draft the primary statements and key notes (accounting policies, revenue, FX, errors), including disclosure of policy changes and prior-period errors. Mapping is largely rules-based/system-driven, but mapping and drafting are kept in one Financial-reporting-owned step since drafting is the substantive judgment activity that consumes the mapped data; the evidential trail from trial balance to disclosed line items is preserved per KB-02, and policy continuity/error correction per KB-05/KB-06.
inputs: Accounting policy change and prior-period error record
steps.name: Map and draft primary statements and key notes

steps.description: The draft statements are analytically reviewed and system-assisted tie-out confirms agreement to the trial balance and supporting schedules, preserving the evidential trail (KB-02) before the draft leaves the preparer function.
steps.name: Analytical review and tie-out

steps.description: Management, independent of the preparer function, reviews and approves the financial statements and supporting tie-out evidence. Actor separation from drafting (TS-04) is preserved to maintain a genuine review control.
steps.name: Management review and approval

steps.description: The approved financial statements are released or submitted, with electronic distribution/filing support where available.
steps.name: Release / submission
